primary_risk: User impersonation via public endpoint could lead to high confidentiality and integrity breaches.
likely_attack_path: Attacker intercepts authentication requests, analyzes token structure, and creates forged tokens to impersonate legitimate users.
security_signals: Unusual authentication patterns detected by AWS WAF
Suspicious token validation errors in CloudTrail logs
investigation_goals: Identify and mitigate user impersonation attempts
Review and strengthen token validation mechanisms
hidden_truth_candidates: Insufficient token validation could lead to broader exploitation of IAM roles
